findings.consequence: If a pallet jams at the entry photo-eye, the conveyor will not stop and the jam alarm will not be raised, violating cause-and-effect CE-ST10-03. This could lead to pallet damage, disruption of flow, or motor burnout.
findings.evidence: Input X11 (Conveyor entry photo-eye PE-1002) is defined in the I/O list but is never used in the ST10 program. M190 is reset in R2 and read in the fault aggregation rung R3, but is never set. The parameter T10 (jam_time, 5.0 s) is also unused.
findings.proposed_fix: Add rungs to implement the jam detection before R2. For example: `LD X11`, `AND Y10`, `OUT T10 K50` to detect the blockage for 5.0 s while running, followed by `LD T10`, `SET M190` to latch the jam alarm.
findings.title: Missing Conveyor Jam Detection Logic

data.summary: The ST10 program correctly implements the motor overload, E-stop interlocks, pallet position sensing, and stopper release. However, the conveyor jam detection logic (CE-ST10-03) has been completely omitted. The entry photo-eye (X11) and jam timer (T10) are missing from the code, and the jam alarm relay (M190) is evaluated but never set.
